about.headline: Two Decades of Color Excellence
about.story:
Phoenix Colour Technologies was founded in Dubai in 2007 with a singular mission: to bring global color science standards to the dynamic and fast-growing markets of the Middle East, Africa, and Asia. What began as a specialist color management consultancy has grown into the region's most trusted partner for precision color, workflow automation, and intelligent manufacturing systems.

Over twenty years, we have built deep expertise across the full color value chain — from spectrophotometric measurement and ICC profiling to press standardization, ink formulation, and shopfloor IoT intelligence. Our team of certified G7 Experts and ISO 12647 specialists brings the same rigor to a flexo press in Lagos as to a gravure line in Riyadh.

Today, we support more than 1,200 companies in print and packaging, brand manufacturing, plastics, paints, textiles, and industrial manufacturing across 20+ countries. Every solution we deliver is engineered with one goal: measurable return on investment within 12 to 16 months.
about.vision: To be the defining force for color accuracy and intelligent manufacturing across emerging markets — enabling every manufacturer, printer, and brand owner in our region to match the precision of the world's best production facilities.
about.mission: We exist to close the gap between global color standards and regional manufacturing reality. We do this by combining best-in-class technology partnerships, certified domain expertise, and relentless after-sales support to deliver solutions that perform — on press, on the shopfloor, and on the balance sheet.

services.title: Color Management Consulting
services.description: From ICC profiling and G7 calibration to press standardization and ISO 12647 compliance — our certified experts diagnose, configure, and verify your color workflow from substrate to delivery.

services.title: Workflow Automation
services.description: Eliminate manual touchpoints and reduce errors across prepress, production, and shipping. We design, install, and support end-to-end automation using best-in-class platforms.
